title: console: remove "Add development environment", its dialog branch, the DEV_ENV_* entitlement copy and the i18n keys; only "create production environment" remains (cloud#3487 D, card B)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate: executing a recorded ruling. objectstack-ai/cloud#3487 was ruled **D** by the maintainer on 2026-11-03 (「同意D」, 「现有的开发环境可以直接归档」, 「立卡之后立刻优先派发处理」). Every organization has exactly one environment, its production environment, and the development type is retired. Ruling of record: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/3487#issuecomment-6595099217. Analysis and file surfaces: https://claude.ai/artifact/2DWMYczN7szdJHWQtC7WSD (last section).

## Ask (`ui/packages/app-shell`)

- Remove the "Add development environment" entry, the development branch of the create-environment dialog, and the `DEV_ENV_*` refusal and entitlement copy, with their i18n keys in every locale bundle.
- Creating a production environment is the only creation path left.
- Tests: no development-environment door renders; the production path is unchanged.

## Order

This card lands with cloud card A, objectstack-ai/cloud#3501, which closes the server doors (`DEV_ENV_RETIRED`). Cloud's next framework pin carries this change. Cloud card D, which removes the development type end to end, waits for that pin.

## Reader

Filed and dispatched by the cloud seat at once, as the maintainer instructed.
